nodes.label: Roundabout Timing (RAT)
nodes.rationale: Browser game (Web/) plus small optional server (Server/); Swift/iPhone track deleted 29.09.2026. Name chosen 30.09.2026; Car Game is only the folder/repo name.

nodes.label: Car Circle (Shoom Games) inspiration
nodes.rationale: One-tap timing: merge cars into a rotating roundabout without steering, gas or brake; the player fits cars into gaps between bot cars.

nodes.label: Shift mode (career)
nodes.rationale: No clock; fixed car count per shift. Short shifts (8-75 s) kept on purpose (Leo 26.09.2026) because they carry the 'one more!' loop; lost level is repeated thanks to instant restart.

nodes.label: Unlimited tiers (Bronze to Master)
nodes.rationale: core/tiers.ts: Bronze 25, Silver 50, Gold 100, Platinum 200, Diamond 350, Master 500 cars; first crossing pays 5 Elite XP.

nodes.label: Mayhem mode
nodes.rationale: Crashes are the goal; flames and chain reactions replace score.

nodes.label: Multiplayer (up to 4, lockstep over WebRTC)
nodes.rationale: Host assigns each tap a step (6 steps ~ 50 ms input delay); all devices simulate the same deterministic world; PeerJS with Cloudflare TURN relay.

nodes.label: Rush Hour (last 4 cars)
nodes.rationale: Tempo 135%, +2 density, points x2; waiting for the perfect gap yields more traffic, not easier.

nodes.label: Hard vs. soft fail rules
nodes.rationale: Normal crash and escaped criminal are hard fails; police crash is soft (3 allowed). Shield upgrade forgives crashes.

nodes.label: Quiet help after losses (careerShift)
nodes.rationale: After 3 lost career shifts the next try draws the smallest car count; assisted shifts set no best time and are not sent as challenges because a friend could not play them identically.

nodes.label: Real crash physics (crash.ts, drivers.ts)
nodes.rationale: Impulse at contact point, 30% rebound, tyre friction, reactive traffic with chain accidents, body damage; no scripted animations.

nodes.label: Scoring: Tight Fit, Near Miss, Perfect, Combo multiplier
Critical Merge
nodes.rationale: 7% of Perfect/Near Miss score x3; draw comes from the seed so same taps give same criticals.

nodes.label: Jammed merges (no points)
nodes.rationale: Fix 01.10.2026: after a crash cars crept in at walking pace, each +1 combo, even giving Unlimited records without play; a car braking into slow traffic timed nothing.

nodes.label: Perfect Chain and Flow State
nodes.rationale: Feedback only (ring glow, sound layer, breathing city), no mode and no text.

nodes.label: Syndicate bosses
nodes.rationale: Every 15th level; since 18.10.2026 spread over prestige ranks because a player plays levels 1-50 then prestiges (bossesPerRank, Careers.bossShift).

nodes.label: Money transporter and Jackpot
nodes.rationale: Exclusion zone: police inside seizes it, normal cars shield it for a bonus. 8% are Jackpot paying 5x.

nodes.label: Ring bots and AI traffic (minRingBots)
nodes.rationale: Player should hit gaps, not form columns; ring always holds 3-5 bots; AI never causes crashes; aiPatience stops starvation of other arms.

nodes.label: Gas tanker and Military truck
nodes.rationale: Tanker wrecks explode in a chain; military truck bomb detonates if a car merges into its zone, losing the shift; smoke is the transition.

nodes.label: Player vehicle types (Compact, Sports, Van, Classic)
nodes.rationale: A type has gameplay values, a skin only looks: different, not better.

nodes.label: Weather system
nodes.rationale: Fair: tap timing never changes; special vehicles and warnings always sit above weather effects.

nodes.label: Night and Blackout
nodes.rationale: Only the picture changes, not the rules; pays more (x1.1 / x1.25).

nodes.label: City Events
nodes.rationale: Events change tempo, density or gaps, never the rules.

nodes.label: Briefings and condition chips
nodes.rationale: First appearance of a special vehicle/boss/condition explains in the top card what to do; build breaks if a brief text is missing.

nodes.label: Economy: earning and spending money
nodes.rationale: Levels outrun money: level 60 after ~1.1-1.6 h with 130-150k earned; Leo kept it (29.09.2026).

nodes.label: Shield upgrade
nodes.rationale: Added 08.10.2026 to soften the level 8-12 loss wall that ended CrazyGames sessions.

nodes.label: Casino (Crash, Slots, Skin-Upgrade, Roulette, Scratch Card, Double or nothing)
nodes.rationale: Casino replaced the Store (Leo 28.09.2026): play money and skins only, odds visible and honest, no purchasable currency while the casino exists. Bet is deducted and saved before the reveal so reloading cannot reroll.

nodes.label: Casino presentation (reveal first, then money)
nodes.rationale: Honest: no fake near-wins, no cheering on loss, every reveal skippable; staging never changes the result.

nodes.label: Unlock ladder (core/unlocks.ts)
nodes.rationale: Spread 29.09.2026: before, five new systems appeared in the first three minutes; now about one every one to four minutes.

nodes.label: One-time hints and notice budget
nodes.rationale: At most three lines after a shift, rest as '+N more'; first shift has no menus so a tap always lands in the game.

nodes.label: Street modules (Toll Booth, Speed Camera, Tow Depot, Billboard, Detour Sign)
nodes.rationale: Detour Sign reworked 06.10.2026: measured effect was minimal because the exit weighting rarely mattered; now cars turn off at 45/60/75%.

nodes.label: Chests (Standard, Premium, Criminal Hunt, Event)
nodes.rationale: Odds always visible; pity: at latest the 10th chest without Epic is at least Epic; no real money.

nodes.label: Skins and Map Skins (cosmetic only)
nodes.rationale: No skin gives a gameplay advantage; special vehicles stay recognisable by shape, not color.

nodes.label: Mastery (8 goals, extended to IV and V)
Daily Shift and streak
nodes.rationale: Daily seed is the same for everyone so the daily leaderboard is fair; Mutator of the day removed 18.10.2026.

nodes.label: Streak Freeze
nodes.rationale: Earned every 7 streak days, never bought, max 2.

nodes.label: Heat (difficulty ladder)
nodes.rationale: One level per 7 days of daily streak; always on, not switchable (Leo 15.10.2026); pays +10% and +2 Elite XP per level.

nodes.label: Tailwind bonus
nodes.rationale: Near-miss loss makes the next shift pay +25%; an early crash gains nothing so players are not encouraged to lose on purpose.

nodes.label: Weekly Shift
nodes.rationale: Renamed from Weekly Elite on 01.10.2026 to avoid confusion with the Elite ladder.

nodes.label: Landmarks (The Etoile)
nodes.rationale: Traffic damped to 65% because the careful bot crashed in one of eight shifts at full traffic. Magic Roundabout still open.

nodes.label: Prestige
nodes.rationale: Back to level 1 at level 50, traffic harder by 10 levels per rank (max +40); late content tied to ranks instead of unreachable levels.

nodes.label: Feats
nodes.rationale: Hardest deeds in the game, never luck, never purchasable.

nodes.label: Season Pass (in-game money, free track)
nodes.rationale: 150,000 play money, never real money; free track from winter 2026 because only paying players earned XP.

nodes.label: Prestige-Chronik (formerly Hall of Fame)
nodes.rationale: Hall of Fame no longer purchasable (18.10.2026); owners keep wall and skin.

nodes.label: Museum (30 entries)
nodes.rationale: Catalog follows content lists; build breaks until level, text and image/color are filled in.

nodes.label: Oversize Load, Street Racers, Wedding convoy
Ring as UI ('one city, one ring')
nodes.rationale: The world is the interface; new info is shown on the roundabout first (island rim, light signals) before classic displays.

nodes.label: Tab bar navigation (Progress, Social, Game, Shop, Build)
nodes.rationale: Native iOS-like feel; tab bar hidden during shifts and until the first shift ends.

nodes.label: CrazyGames distribution (?crazygames)
nodes.rationale: Same URL with query flag, no separate build; SDK loads only then; no midgame ads.

nodes.label: Google Play Trusted Web Activity (?googleplaystore)
nodes.rationale: No own build: each deploy reaches the app immediately and shares save/offline with the browser game.

nodes.label: Leaderboard service (Server/)
nodes.rationale: Small optional Node 22 + Hono + SQLite service; game runs offline-first without it; anti-cheat via plausibility limits only; money and chests computed locally.

nodes.label: Cloud sync by sync code
nodes.rationale: Chosen over file export and over password account (Leo 01.10.2026); never silently overwrite, ask on conflict; source of truth stays the browser.

nodes.label: Rewarded ads (voluntary only)
nodes.rationale: Only voluntary rewarded ads, paid only when watched to the end; AdSense loads only after the game is on screen and never on CrazyGames.

nodes.label: Legal and privacy (legal.ts)
nodes.rationale: A new service that receives data needs a paragraph and a new LEGAL_UPDATED.

nodes.label: Technical architecture (core / present / audio / storage / net / ui)
nodes.rationale: Vite + TypeScript + HTML5 Canvas, no UI framework or game engine; game rules only in core/, no DOM.

nodes.label: Deterministic simulation (same seed + taps = same result)
nodes.rationale: Basis for balancing bots, challenge links, trials, weekly shift and multiplayer; luck draws use a separate stream of the same seed.

nodes.label: Balancing bots and sim scripts
nodes.rationale: The careful bot must never crash; random tapper almost always does.

nodes.label: Web/src/core/config.ts (all tuning values)
nodes.rationale: Authoritative for all numbers; if this document differs from the code, the code wins.

nodes.label: Patch notes (patchNotes.ts)
nodes.rationale: One entry per day, newest first, with summary and long items list.

nodes.label: Decisions log (Entscheidungen)
nodes.rationale: Browser game instead of app; Casino instead of Store; Swift track deleted; optional server allowed; Cloud sync by code.

hyperedges.label: Late content tied to prestige ranks
Optional online services around the offline-first game
